assessment: The six-year pattern is specific enough to preserve an issue-level lead. Each displayed2002–2005 gap reconstructs the cited planned marginal tobacco increments after rounding, whose exact sum8.384billion rounds8.4. The2006–2007 gaps each match2.123billion from the2003 bill. This is affirmative source-category evidence, beyond failure to locate a source. But a marginal fiscal estimate is not the same thing as an authenticated total-receipt forecast, and the arithmetic reconstruction does not prove the author’s actual method or exclude an unknown original forecast series. Thus a proven false8.4billion miss is not yet established.
benign_alternatives_and_gates: An earlier total-revenue forecast vintage, cash-versus-assessed-revenue basis, or industry synthesis might explain the total series. Those alternatives require authentication; the cited incremental bills alone do not resolve them.
May2001 baseline12.0/12.1/12.2/12.3 precedes the tax packages and is diagnostic, not a definitive corrected reform-inclusive forecast.

The supplementary2002 budget must combine old12.4billion tobacco line with the separate1.0billion tax-measure line. Using12.4alone would omit an explicitly budgeted measure. Its revised13.35billion total is another particular vintage.
The October2001 original draft was visually checked and has different tobacco increments from the November committee version; it does not reproduce all displayed annual gaps.

Even an authenticated forecast miss would not establish the causal effect of tax increases. The original2003 rationale itself discusses stockpiling and timing around rate changes, illustrating why receipt comparisons cannot isolate causation.
The author also relies on foreign-country cases and a commissioned forward-looking model. This review does not refute those arguments or validate current revenue forecasts.
materiality: Potentially major: the quantified historical failure is used centrally to argue that renewed increases risk missing fiscal expectations. This is conditional materiality of an unresolved source-description allegation, not an established major error.
direction: True conditionally: the asserted historical shortfall strengthens the explicit request to avoid abrupt increases. No corrected realised or causal shortfall is offered, and policy wisdom is not inferred.
recommendations: Keep unresolved wording prominent in card and narrative.
Do not describe the source-pattern reconstruction as proof of how the author calculated the table.
Do not treat absence of an authenticated baseline as proof that no such baseline ever existed.
quotes: No further original submission quotations reproduced; shared request quotation and original source budget preserved.
